claims.statement: For K states, known reporter W_kappa=kappa I+(1-kappa)U, uniform stationary start, and all legal candidate transition matrices doubly stochastic with Dobrushin coefficient <=r with 0<r<1; if r=0 the transcript laws are identical uniformly in kappa, any shared history-adaptive randomized action policy has full-transcript KL at most 8 K^3 n kappa^4 (r/(1-r))^2. Testing both errors <=delta<1/2 requires n >= (1-2delta)^2(1-r)^2/(4 K^3 r^2 kappa^4) observations.
assumptions: The same observation-dependent action policy is used in both candidate worlds
Uniform stationary law is preserved by every action in both worlds
Reporter W_kappa is known to the tester and 0<kappa<=1/2
Every action kernel has a Dobrushin coefficient bounded by one fixed r<1 independent of kappa
No cadence-dependent wall-time or photon-price improvement is assumed
claims.novelty: UNKNOWN; Dobrushin controlled-filter stability is established prior art; no priority claim for the exact weak-reporter KL argument
claims.costs: Observation count n has the displayed Omega(kappa^-4) lower bound; multiply by a uniform per-observation time or photon price only when such a positive lower bound is separately established. The fixed cycle finite constant is weak at kappa=0.1.
claims.falsifier: A full-sequence adaptive test in the declared action class with o(kappa^-4) observations and fixed worst-case error.
claims.scope_limit: Does not cover action/cadence families with r approaching one as kappa decreases, nonuniform stationary laws, state-dependent permutation controls, or general HMMs.
claims.next_gate: Prove a uniform cadence-dependent KL bound after pricing photon rate, read integration, wall time, and disturbance, or identify a validated physical control set satisfying the fixed-r conditions.
